name: Handstand Push-Up
steps: Plant your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width near a wall and kick into a handstand with your heels lightly supported.
Brace your abs and glutes to hold a tight body line.
Bend your elbows and bring your head toward the floor just ahead of your hands, keeping your weight on your palms.
Press the floor away to return to straight arms, then lower one foot at a time to finish.
tips: Keep your forearms vertical and elbows angled slightly forward rather than flaring straight out to the sides.
Control the descent all the way to the bottom instead of dropping onto your head.
